# Plasti Dip application and repair

## Summary

[Partial] Apply Plasti Dip using spray cans at 70 degrees Fahrenheit with consistent distance. [t1811]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Ensure the spray cans are at or above 70 degrees Fahrenheit for proper atomization.
2. Maintain can temperature by placing them in a bucket of hot water if needed.
3. [Partial] Alternate between two different cans to prevent clogging and ensure even coverage.
4. Limit continuous spraying time on one can to no more than 2 minutes before swapping.

_Procedure reported by [t1811]._

## Tools

- Spray cans [t1811]
- [Partial] Bucket for hot water [t1811]

## Tips & gotchas

- Clean the nozzle frequently during application. [t1811]
- Maintain a consistent distance from the object being sprayed to control texture and gloss. [t1811]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Spraying too far away or reaching awkwardly, which causes uneven coverage on wide nozzles. [t1811]
